$description: Real breakpoints used repeatedly across the codebase (Tailwind arbitrary min-width variants). Not a config-declared scale (project uses default Tailwind screens plus ad hoc min-[Npx]: variants) — this is a grep-verified histogram of the values actually used.

sm-640.usage: rare, menu-bar item visibility on inference-runtime browser mock

md-768.usage: Tailwind default md:, used for icon sizing / minor layout shifts

nav-810.usage: the dominant mobile/desktop split across nearly every page and section — nav collapse, hero column stacking, card grid collapse

lg-1024.usage: Tailwind default lg:, careers page padding steps

product-1200.usage: hero two-column split point on product pages, matches shell maxWidth

shell-1240.usage: point at which shell padding drops to 0 (shell hits its 1200px cap with room to spare)

note: 810px is the single most load-bearing breakpoint in this design system — nearly every section's mobile/desktop split happens there, not at Tailwind's default md (768px).
